fluff.overview:
The Claymore class assault DropShip is a compact Aerodyne combat vessel built at the orbital shipyards above Skye. Weighing 1,400 tons, the Claymore was designed to fill the need for a fast, heavily armed assault platform capable of independent raiding operations and fleet escort duties. Its distinctive swanlike silhouette sets it apart from other assault DropShips, and its combination of speed and firepower makes it a dangerous opponent in close engagements.

Though small for an assault vessel, the Claymore carries armor protection rivaling much larger designs and mounts a formidable weapons array concentrated in its forward arcs. Critics have noted that its broadside and rear firepower could be stronger, but the design's speed and maneuverability compensate for this perceived shortcoming.
fluff.capabilities:
The base Claymore concentrates most of its firepower in six nose bays. The forward arc mounts an ER PPC, an ER large laser, an LRM-20 rack, a large pulse laser, two medium lasers, two medium pulse lasers, a Streak SRM-2 launcher, and an LB 10-X autocannon. Each wing carries two large lasers, an LRM-10, an LB 10-X autocannon, a medium laser, and a Streak SRM-2. The aft arc provides an ER PPC, an LRM-20, two small pulse lasers, a large pulse laser, and an LB 10-X autocannon. Forty-seven double heat sinks manage the thermal load from this arsenal.

The vessel carries 800 points of armor, exceptional for its tonnage class, and maintains a safe thrust of 4g with a structural integrity rating of 12. A cargo bay provides 327 tons of storage capacity, and a crew of twenty-three operates the vessel efficiently.
fluff.deployment: The original Claymore entered service with the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth and was deployed primarily along the Clan occupation zone border, where its speed and heavy forward armament proved ideal for raiding operations and escort duties. The Sixth Lyran Guards conducted the first combat trials, and the design subsequently saw broader adoption across Federated Commonwealth and later Lyran Alliance naval forces.
fluff.history:
The Claymore project began in 3047 at the Shipil yards orbiting Skye amid great secrecy. Within two years, production of a prototype was set to begin, but the arrival of the Clans in 3049 prompted the AFFC to redirect resources toward new BattleMech designs, and the Claymore project was suspended. In late 3050, the battle at Radstadt demonstrated the relative vulnerability of Clan aerospace assets, leading the AFFC to reassess its priorities. Prince Hanse Davion instigated a number of projects to bolster Federated Commonwealth aerospace forces and reactivated the Claymore project.

The prototype took on its trademark swanlike appearance by August of 3053, and the FCS Claymore made its maiden flight by year's end. Six months later, the Sixth Lyran Guards were testing the new vessel on combat raids. The Claymore received AFFC approval the following year and entered full-scale production, with Shipil producing one vessel approximately every nine months. Three of the early production craft were stationed along the edge of the Clan occupation zone, where the design's speed and firepower proved valuable for reconnaissance-in-force missions and raiding operations.
